messages:
Priya Nair: FYI two customers opened tickets today: BetaMetrics says ~150k tokens missing; GammaApps says they were billed for tokens they didn't send. Both point to the same request_id pattern r_xxx. Can eng check for any canonicalization collisions?
Ethan Cole: I pulled the ingest logs and saw we canonicalize and sometimes truncate long request_ids to 12 chars to save space. That created collisions where different orgs had the same truncated id. Example: full ids: 
  BetaMetrics: r_full_2026_abcdef1234567890 -> truncated r_full_2026_abc
  GammaApps: r_long_2026_xyz9876543210 -> truncated r_full_2026_abc
This caused the billing aggregator to attribute some events to the wrong org.
Marta Ivanova: Can you paste a sample of the conflicting events?
Ethan Cole: Sample lines: ```json
{"ts":"2026-06-11T11:02:05Z","org":"beta-metrics","req_id":"r_full_2026_abcdef1234567890","trunc_id":"r_full_2026_abc","tokens":1200}
{"ts":"2026-06-11T11:02:06Z","org":"gamma-apps","req_id":"r_long_2026_xyz9876543210","trunc_id":"r_full_2026_abc","tokens":1150}```
Ethan Cole: The ledger join uses trunc_id for partitioning in the fast path; collisions resulted in ~152,300 tokens being assigned to the wrong org across that one-hour window.
Priya Nair: Oof. So BetaMetrics underbilled, GammaApps overbilled. What's the net token delta per org?
Ethan Cole: Quick aggregate from billing_mirror: ```sql
SELECT org, sum(tokens) as tokens_assigned
FROM metering_ledger_shadow
WHERE trunc_id='r_full_2026_abc' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-06-11T11:00:00Z' AND '2026-06-11T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY org;
-- result: beta-metrics: 12,340 tokens (should be 164,640)
-- result: gamma-apps: 164,640 tokens (should be 12,340)
```
Ethan Cole: Delta for beta-metrics = +152,300 tokens missing (underbilled); gamma-apps = +152,300 tokens overbilled. Dollar impact: beta-metrics should be charged an extra $15.23; gamma-apps overcharged $15.23.
Marta Ivanova: Customers asked for CSVs showing per-event attribution and an explanation. Finance: do we prefer to correct the ledger (re-assign events) or issue balancing credits/debits per customer?
Priya Nair: Prefer correcting the ledger so future invoices match actual usage and keep audit trail. For already paid invoices, we'll issue adjustments. Need engineering dry-run that reassigns events based on full req_id and produces CSV + checksum. Also need an ops fix: stop truncating request_ids in the fast path.
Jared Kim: Will run dry-run backfill that uses the full req_id to remap trunc_id joins and produce per-event before/after owner fields. ETA 2 hours. Will include original trunc_id, full_req_id, original_org, corrected_org, and tokens.
billing-bot: Precheck: cross-org reassign backfill requires (1) snapshot export (2) dry-run CSV + md5 (3) finance approval.
Ethan Cole: Also created ENG ticket ENG-6320 to remove truncation and ensure full req_id is used for attribution keys.
Marta Ivanova: Approve dry-run. Once CSV available we'll review and authorize commit.
Jared Kim: Dry-run complete. Uploaded CSV s3://fin-audit/dryruns/1807504321-cross-org-reattrib.csv md5=1f4b7c8d9a0e2f3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c2d. Rows=1,120. Reassigned tokens total = 152300.
Priya Nair: Finance review: confirmed per-event diffs and checksums. Approve ledger correction and controlled commit. For GammaApps, we'll issue a one-time refund of $15.23 and a corrective invoice; for BetaMetrics we'll issue a one-time bill adjustment of $15.23. Please include both customer notes and CSVs. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Commit gated: awaiting accounting reconciliation ID and final ENG sign-off for truncation fix.
Jared Kim: Running controlled commit now; backfill will attach an audit_marker reassign_run_id=reauth-1807504321. Will post commit CSV and md5 when done.
Ethan Cole: Post-commit: ledger shows corrected owners for the window. Commit CSV uploaded s3://fin-audit/commits/1807504321-commit.csv md5=8c9d0b1a2e3f4c5d6b7a8e9f0c1d2b3a. I also deployed a short-term hotfix to stop truncation; long-term fix in ENG-6320.
Marta Ivanova: Sending customer notes now with attached CSV and short explanation: 'We discovered a truncation collision on internal request id keys that caused a small set of events to be assigned incorrectly. We corrected our ledger, issued refund/adjustment, and implemented a fix to prevent recurrence.'
Priya Nair: Please add FIN-2026-089 for tracking and include a short postmortem in finance/incidents. Thanks team.
billing-bot: All gating checks passed; backfill commit completed and accounting adjustments queued.
